_notes: The STYLE LOCK. Locked values are added to every prompt - this is what makes a batch of 10 images look like one shoot.
Tuned for FOOD & DRINK imagery. Rename brand_name/campaign and adjust the palette once, then leave it alone.
'look'      -> applies to EVERY use case (colour grade, materials, mood).
'studio'    -> applies only to the use cases listed in 'studio_use_cases' (clean, controlled setups).
Styled food shots (food-hero, flat-lay) keep their own scene/lighting from the recipe,
so a styled tabletop never inherits a seamless studio backdrop.
Resolution order per prompt line: request-sheet column -> brand lock -> recipe default.
Empty strings are skipped, so delete whatever you do not want.
Food-specific rule: tasteful props ARE wanted (appetite appeal), unlike hard-goods catalogues -
the avoid list targets clutter and fake-looking food instead of props in general.

look.palette: fresh natural colours, plenty of green and red accents on white crockery, light wood and white surfaces
look.materials: real food texture: crumb and crust, glossy sauce, fresh herbs, natural moisture
look.mood: honest, fresh, home-kitchen made - appetizing without looking staged

studio.scene: white or light-wood table, plain neutral background, no props other than the plate and its sides
studio.style: natural daylight food photography, honest portions, served-as-is plating
studio.lighting: soft daylight from the side-left with gentle fill, natural shadows, no harsh specular highlights
studio.framing: plate centred and fully inside frame, camera at 35-45 degrees or slightly overhead, plate fills about 75% of the frame

global_constraints: photographic realism with one consistent light direction
the dish exactly as the kitchen serves it: same ingredients, same portion, same plating
colour, shape and proportions true to the reference image
global_avoid: ingredients that are not in the dish description
misspelled, invented or unapproved text or claims
unapproved health, nutrition or certification claims
HDR look, heavy vignette or oversaturated colour
